title: PayoutBatch (DRAFT)
description: Money out to a verified payee (FIN-007). Proposed by the Forest Committee Chair, approved by the President under dual_control, executed by the provider. DRAFT — not approved.

payeeAccountId.description: FIN-008: must reference a payee whose provider KYB verification succeeded.

lines.description: Frozen once the batch leaves 'proposed', enforced by a database trigger. Adding a line after approval is the approve-then-swap attack applied to money.

approvalRequestId.description: FIN-007: required before the batch may leave 'proposed'. The approval binds to this batch id specifically.

approvedContentDigest.description: Fingerprint of the lines at approval time. Execution recomputes it and refuses on mismatch.

_note: Funds move provider-to-payee. The platform authorizes and records but never takes custody, which is the difference between recordkeeping and money transmission. See the compliance note in the proposal README.
